name: How to Rescue a Reef
summary: The “How to Rescue a Reef” underwater experience emulates the real-world coral reef research and restoration efforts led by the University of Miami Rosenstiel School’s (UM) Rescue a Reef program. Rescue a Reef (RAR) is UM’s coral conservation program designed to build community and coastal resilience through coral reef education, restoration, and citizen science. To accomplish this, RAR hosts public field expeditions led by UM coral scientists that provide a unique, hands-on opportunity for recreational SCU
